purpose: Single-open accordion: all rows start closed, clicking the open row closes it; body height animates 0 <-> auto, the plus icon rotates 45deg, hover draws the icon circle.

motion.sequence: each row reveals at threshold 0.1: its top line draws on mount, title splits (stagger 0.03), icon and body fade

securityNote: the source injects the body as raw HTML; the PageSpec contract therefore forbids markup in body text (rule NO_MARKUP_IN_TEXT)
